rationale: Genome-wide CRISPRa (Calabrese pool A) sort screen in primary CD4+ T cells from three donors (D11a/D12a/D13a; the sorted GFP reporter marks infected cells). Each donor's reporter-negative and reporter-positive sorts are paired, so donor is a blocking factor (~ donor + bin), 6 libraries, 2 residual df. Antiviral factors that reduce the reporter are enriched in the reporter-negative sort, so a positive binGFPneg estimate is the paper's main direction. The GFP-Total and Uninfected columns are not used. Controls are the 496 NO-TARGET guides. calB (pool B) and the genome-wide CRISPRn screen are run as separate designs (design_calB.json, design_crisprn.json).
